verdict.rationale: Apify exposes a full OpenAPI-documented REST API (apify-probe-2), a CLI to control the platform from terminal/scripts (apify-docs-3, apify-probe-4), and an official MCP server letting AI agents/LLMs discover and run Actors programmatically (apify-docs-10, apify-probe-3), covering actor development, running, scheduling, monitoring, and data export via API (apify-docs-15). This indicates near-complete parity between UI and programmatic/API access for AI-native users.
